response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(t.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(t.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM type_counts t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.cnt > o.avg_cnt;
